facts.text: I did enjoy the starter, Clarice. Tell me what you thought of the main and I'll tell you the wine.
facts.why: Lecter never says this. It is an invented line in his voice, and it is printed as a letter from his desk, not as a film quote. The Chianti line the menu is hinting at is a different line. Quote pages show a real short line from him at the end of the film.
facts.fix: I do wish we could chat longer, but I'm having an old friend for dinner.

fix_note.text: I do wish we could chat longer, but I'm having an old friend for dinner.

facts.text: Pour the red when Clarice first sits down across the glass from Lecter.
facts.why: The Chianti line comes at the end of the first interview, when Clarice is at the glass. Nothing shows her sitting down, and no wine is poured at that point.
facts.fix: Pour the red when Lecter mentions a nice Chianti with the census taker.

facts.text: The good doctor's pick. Chilton never gets one.
facts.why: Chianti is Lecter's wine in his famous line, and Chilton is the hospital director who is his rival. Menu joke.

vibe.verdict: A good FBI breakroom roster with the moth, the glass cell and the Chianti, but the main note is invented and the tone stays politely creepy rather than properly dark.
